faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IIT Delhi Sr. Research Fellow Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting applications by email for the IIT Delhi Sr. Research Fellow post is 11 September 2026. Candidates are advised to apply well in advance of the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Sr. Research Fellow posts at IIT Delhi?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Sr. Research Fellow post in the Indian Institute of Technology Delhi recruitment drive for 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for IIT Delhi Sr. Research Fellow Recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for the Sr. Research Fellow posts at IIT Delhi is Email. Interested candidates need to send their applications to the official email address.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for the Sr. Research Fellow position at IIT Delhi?
faq.answer: The salary for the Sr. Research Fellow position is Rs 42,000/- p.m plus HRA @27%. This is a contractual position at IIT Delhi.

faq.question: Q5. What are the essential qualifications for the Sr. Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have M Sc/B Tech in Physics/EP/Electronics with 80% marks and 02 years minimum work experience with 'NET/GATE'. Work experience in Raman Spectroscopy is preferred.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for IIT Delhi Sr. Research Fellow Recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the IIT Delhi Sr. Research Fellow Recruitment 2026. The fee is Nil for all.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Sr. Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Sr. Research Fellow position involves two stages: Shortlisting of applications followed by an Online Interview for the shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the job be located if selected?
faq.answer: The job location for the Sr. Research Fellow position will be New Delhi, Delhi, as the recruiting organization is the Indian Institute of Technology Delhi.

faq.question: Q9. What is the official website for IIT Delhi recruitment?
faq.answer: The official website for IIT Delhi recruitment and related information is http://ird.iitd.ac.in. Candidates can visit this site for more details and updates.

faq.question: Q10. Can NET/GATE requirement be relaxed for any candidates?
faq.answer: Yes, the NET/GATE requirement may be relaxed for CFTI (Centrally Funded Technical Institutions) graduates who have a CGPA greater than 8.000.
